description: Get this AmpleRun account's own deposit address and the networks it is watched on (`networks`: Base first, plus any of Arbitrum, Ethereum, OP Mainnet, Polygon, BNB Chain, Avalanche the operator has switched on). The address is the same on every listed network. Send USDC or USDT (credited 1:1) or the network's own coin (ETH, POL, BNB, AVAX: credited in USD at the Chainlink price at finality minus `native.spread_bps`; `native.quote_micro_per_coin` is the live quote) from any wallet or exchange: no wallet linking, no transaction hash. Each deposit is credited once, after that network's finality (state SEEN, then CREDITED; HELD means over a balance cap and credited once there is room). Funds sent on a network not in `networks` are not credited. The address never changes; the first call creates it. Read-only otherwise; needs AMPLERUN_API_KEY.
name: get_deposit_address
title: Get the account's deposit address
